name: rw-generate-video
headline: Promo Video Skill: AI Video Creation
short_description: The Promo Video Skill is designed for users looking to create engaging promotional videos automatically. It simplifies the video creation process, making it accessible for developers and marketers.
author: divakarwl12

sections.overview:
The Promo Video Skill automates professional promotional video creation by combining Remotion video animation, ElevenLabs AI voiceover generation, and background music mixing. Users answer questions about their product, select video duration (30s/60s/90s), theme, and voice, then the skill builds a complete MP4 video with animations and transitions. It handles all technical complexity—Remotion, React, npm packages, and ffmpeg audio mixing are automatically installed and configured. Developers and marketers benefit from a production-ready workflow that eliminates manual video editing while maintaining professional quality.
Create promotional videos for product launches
Generate highlight reels for events
Produce engaging social media content
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/divakarwl12/skills --skill promo-video`
`git clone https://github.com/divakarwl12/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Create a promotional video script and storyboard for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. Use the following details: [PRODUCT/SERVICE NAME], [KEY FEATURES], [TARGET AUDIENCE], and [CALL TO ACTION]. The video should be 30-60 seconds long and include a hook, problem statement, solution, and closing hook. Provide a storyboard with scene descriptions, visuals, and suggested text-to-speech voice style. Suggest royalty-free background music and sound effects.
```
